## 问题与结果 / Problem and outcome

说明触发条件、此前行为与修改后行为。 / Describe the trigger and before/after behavior.

## 变更范围 / Scope

相关模块、协议、数据来源或双语文档。 / Modules, contracts, data sources or bilingual policies affected.

## 验证 / Verification

实际运行的检查与结果，另列未执行的真实服务/浏览器验收。 / Checks actually run and their results; separately list live-service/browser acceptance not performed.

## 升级与许可 / Upgrade and licensing

迁移顺序、兼容性、恢复方法、依赖/素材来源及许可变化；不适用时说明。 / Migration order, compatibility, recovery, dependency/asset provenance and licensing changes, or explain why not applicable.

- [ ] 无真实令牌、Cookie、私钥、用户资料或数据库导出 / No live tokens, cookies, private keys, user data or database exports
- [ ] 规范变化同步中英文及政策版本 / Policy changes update both languages and revision
- [ ] 保留第三方声明；不把来源当作授权 / Third-party notices retained; provenance is not permission
- [ ] 安全问题通过 SECURITY.md 的私密渠道处理 / Security issues handled through the private channel in SECURITY.md

请不要在公开 PR 中披露未修复漏洞细节。代码审核与 Wiki 审核分别进行，发布机器人不合并 main。 / Do not disclose unfixed vulnerability details in public PRs. Code and Wiki review are separate; the publisher does not merge main.
